title: Keep Your Pipes Flowing Smoothly
description: A slow-draining sink or shower is often a warning sign before a complete clog happens. To keep your plumbing running smoothly, prevent debris from entering your pipes. Use drain strainers in kitchen sinks and bathroom showers to catch food scraps, hair, and soap scum. Avoid pouring cooking oils or fats down the drain, as they solidify inside pipes over time. Flushing your drains weekly with warm water helps clear minor buildup naturally. If water begins backing up or you notice persistent foul odors, avoid harsh chemical cleaners. Instead, schedule a professional plumbing inspection to safely resolve the underlying issue before major pipe damage occurs.
